summary: With the Source Wall cracked, multiple universes are merging into our own. Along with the new threats also come new allies: the Council of Wonder Women! Take up arms with Nubia, Flashpoint Wonder Woman, Red Son Wonder Woman, and more, face the Olympian Gods and the New Gods, and restore order before it is too late.

sections.title: Overview
items: July 30th, 2020

sections.title: New Episode: Wonderverse
items: With the Source Wall cracked, multiple universes are merging into our own. Along with the new threats also come new allies: the Council of Wonder Women! Take up arms with Nubia, Flashpoint Wonder Woman, Red Son Wonder Woman, and more, face the Olympian Gods and the New Gods, and restore order before it is too late.

Wonderverse features new daily and weekly Open World missions, raid-like world bosses, a brand-new Solo and Alert, as well as Normal and Elite versions of a new Raid! To play this content mode your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 299.
For a limited time, special “Event” versions of all content for Wonderverse will be available to all players, level 10+ as well! Look for these Event versions in the Events tab of your On Duty menu.

sections.title: New Open World Missions – Wonderverse: Patchwork Themyscira
items: Look for Wonderverse: Patchwork Themyscira in your Warp Menu or use the teleporter in the Watchtower or Hall of Doom
New Daily and Weekly missions in Patchwork Themyscira
Minimum Level: 15

sections.title: New Solo – Wonderverse: Temples of Power
items: Source Wall fragments are being attracted to places of power around Themyscira. Head into the Temples and prevent the fragments from being stolen.
Open your On Duty Menu and look for Wonderverse: Temples of Power under Tier 10 of the 1 Player Tab.
Combat Rating: 299
For the Event Version – look for Wonderverse: Temples of Power (Event) in the On Duty Menu under the Events Tab.
Minimum Level: 15

sections.title: New Alert – Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea
items: Instead of turning over her share of Source Wall fragments, Queen Diana has sealed herself inside the Crypt of Penthesilea. Travel there and meet with Nubia. Together maybe you can convince Queen Diana to see reason.
Open your On Duty Menu and look for Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea under Tier 10 of the 4 Player Tab.
Combat Rating: 299
For the Event Version – look Wonderverse: Crypt of Penthesilea (Event) in the On Duty Menu under the Events Tab.
Minimum Level: 15

sections.title: New Raid – Wonderverse: Fractured God Sphere
items: We’ve learned from Poseidon that the Sphere of the Gods is crumbling and the Gods themselves have been collecting Source Wall shards to try and repair it. The Council of Wonder Women know we need those shards to repair the universe. Enter the God Sphere and reclaim the shards.
Open your On Duty Menu and look for Wonderverse: Fractured God Sphere under Expert Tier 10 of the 8 Player Tab.
Combat Rating: 299
For the Event Version – look for Wonderverse: Fractured God Sphere (Event) in the On Duty Menu under the Events Tab.
Minimum Level: 15

sections.title: New Gear, Base Items, Feats and More
items: Earn new event currencies: Splintered Coins and Empyrean Aether!
New Artifacts and Augments!
Acquire new gear inspired by Grail!
Plus collect new base items, feats, and more!

sections.title: Episode 35
items: Monsters of Metal (Elite) should not sort below (Normal) in the On Duty menu

sections.title: Powers
items: Doom Spin damage decreased by approximately 44%.
Clobber Damage Increased by 29%.
Mega Smash damage increased by 60% when fully charged.
Changed Dual Wield Flurry Shot to do it's fourth tick of damage at the end of it's animation.

sections.title: Artifacts
items: Fixed issue with the Strategist Card Artifact to where not all HoTs/DoTs/PoTs would show up as "Tactical Advantage."
Increased damage of Might's Tactical Advantage to be more in line with Precision's Tactical Advantage with the Strategist Card.

sections.title: Augments
items: Origin Augments max rank increased from 267 to 277.

sections.title: Gear
items: All Avatar Bombardier gear now scales to 272.
Magic Supply Crystal will no longer remove mind control in Elite content.

sections.title: Legends
items: Fixed issue where Legends character Atrocitus would not self heal when using Rage of the Butcher supercharge.
Fixed issue where Heal Barrels from Legends PvP would not heal properly.

sections.title: General
items: PC is now capped at 60 fps by default, up from 30 fps. Players can toggle it back down to 30 fps in the video options menu.
Training dummies no longer heal players, but instead provide power. This should allow for better testing of powerset abilities and artifacts.
World Boss overlays will now have a distinct color.
Fixed a bug where tooltips for already collected base themes would not update.
Players will no longer hear ignored players through Voice Chat.
Players will no longer receive instance invites from players they are ignoring.
Players that are excused from an instance will now be removed from the group and will not be given a penalty.
Fixed a bug where the Pet UI wouldn't appear or would show incorrect data.
Removed extra FX on the following orbitals: St. Patty's Day, Calculator, Oracle, and Source.
Damage done to self will no longer count as damage dealt in the combat log.
Channeled melee abilities will no longer be interrupted by auto-jumping when cast against flying enemies.
Rearranged quick menu.

title: Game Update 106
summary: Harvest and Roar will not benefit from other player’s poison/pheromone applications.

sections.title: Overview
items: September 18, 2020

sections.title: Nature
items: Poisons/Pheromones
Poisons and Pheromones are no longer shared.
Harvest and Roar will not benefit from other player’s poison/pheromone applications.
Fixed an issue where Grimorium Verum's Nature power interaction (Void Poison) was not applying extra damage towards Roar.

sections.title: Supercharges
items: Wolf Form Changes
Cooldown increased to 30 seconds (up from 12 seconds).
Supercharge cost increased to 5000 (up from 2500).
Buff duration increased to 15 second (up from 13 seconds).
Healers will no longer get 10% damage increase for DPS role while in wolf form.
Fixed an issue where DPS were getting an additional 10% DPS role buff while in wolf form.
Gorilla Form Changes
Healers will no longer get 10% damage increase for DPS role while in gorilla form.
Fixed an issue where DPS were getting an additional 10% DPS role buff while in gorilla form.
Reduced temporary buff duration while in gorilla form to 15 seconds (down from 20 seconds).
Reduced temporary damage buff from gorilla form to 30% (down from 35%).
Fixed an issue where countering an enemy was doing excessive damage.
Insectoid Form Changes
Cooldown increased to 30 seconds (up from 12 seconds).
Supercharge cost increased to 5000 (up from 2500).
Temporary buff duration increased to 15 seconds (up from 13 seconds).
NEW Tactical Mod for Insectoid Form that returns Supercharge back.
Canine Form Changes
Increased the cooldown of Dog Form to 30 seconds (up from 12).

sections.title: Artifact & Augment
items: Solar Amplifier; Fixed an issue where the incorrect FX was called for rank 200 Solar Amplifier.; Fixed an issue where Solar Amplifier was accidentally splitting damage on the burning damage over time.; Fixed an issue where Solar Amplifier explosion was splitting damage on primary target.; Changed Solar Amplifier to where burn is applied to primary target instantly.

Items that can be fortified, such as artifacts and augments, now have a hard cap on their max experience that can be added. This prevents players from accidentally wasting experience in an already max artifact.

sections.title: HUD
items: The arrow indicator when the Hard Target Lock is off screen will now be shown on top of other Game UI.

sections.title: UI
items: Resolved an issue that caused certain text to be translated into the wrong language.
Scorecard should now show an Icon for Daily Complete.

sections.title: Tactical Mods
items: Updated Wolf form tactical mod to last 15 seconds (up from 12) to match the new duration of the temporary buff of wolf form.
Fixed an issue where Wolf Form tactical head mod would not grant extra critical strike chance.

sections.title: Missions
items: The Will of Darkseid is now available for Cross-Faction play.

title: Game Update 108
summary: Larfleeze is back! Find and recover the stolen gifts in Metropolis and Gotham City before it’s too late! Look for “ Yuletide Fear” (Villains) or “ Winter Plunderland” (Heroes) in your Mission Journal. Or alternatively you can now use the Warp Menu to head directly to the Watchtower or Hall of Doom by selecting Season’s Greedings: Hal Jordan (Hero) or Season’s Greedings: Sinestro (Villain). There are also wondrous...

sections.title: Overview
items: December 7th, 2020

sections.title: Season's Greedings
items: Larfleeze is back! Find and recover the stolen gifts in Metropolis and Gotham City before it’s too late! Look for “ Yuletide Fear” (Villains) or “ Winter Plunderland” (Heroes) in your Mission Journal. Or alternatively you can now use the Warp Menu to head directly to the Watchtower or Hall of Doom by selecting Season’s Greedings: Hal Jordan (Hero) or Season’s Greedings: Sinestro (Villain). There are also wondrous new feats to be found, along with style items and accessories to be earned!
New Feats!; All the Trimmings; Happy Fraggin’ Holidays; Wrap god

Larfleeze’s greed can’t be satisfied so he is taking advantage of a heated battle between the Green Lanterns and the Sinestro Corps. Look for “Ring in the Holidays” in your Mission Journal. Players must complete “Yuletide Fear” or “Winter Plunderland” and “Season’s Greedings” in order to receive the “Ring in the Holidays” Daily Mission.

Each day of the event, look for “ Season's Greedings” and “ Ring in the Holidays” in your Mission Journal to complete the mission and earn Holly Leaves. Don’t forget to shop at Skeets’ Workshop to get the latest winter clothing, holiday goodies, and festive base items!

sections.title: Chat
items: Players can now tell/say/shout and proximity voice chat with other players of the opposite faction

sections.title: Loot
items: Auto-Equipping Rings will now replace the lowest item level equipped Ring

sections.title: Audio
items: Headline Movies should now always play voices. If the movie is not available in the current language, it will play the English Audio.
Random sound cues should not be played during Cutscenes

sections.title: Artifacts
items: Fixed issue where Computo's Redistributor HUD would not gather precision damage from Ice Elemental, Wolf Form, Gorilla Form, and Insectoid Form

sections.title: Winter Gift
items: Larfleeze noticed the very slightly late start to the event and demanded compensation. Because we made a special gift for him, we thought we would share it with everyone!
Look for a gift of winter currency to arrive starting December 8, 2020. One per account.

sections.title: Convergence of Unmaking
items: Some abilities have been adjusted to ensure they hit Mordru. This is an ongoing effort and more issues with abilities will be resolved over time.
Abilities that are spheres now work correctly, but work continues on abilities that are cones and fields.

sections.title: New Henchmen Uplink Device: Lantern Corps!
items: During this year's Winter event, three new Henchmen Uplink Devices inspired by the Green Lantern Corps, Red Lantern Corps, and Sinestro Corps will have a chance to drop from ANY On Duty mission boss in the game. Who can say humbug to Lantern henchmen?

title: Game Update 109
summary: The anniversary event is back this year for our 10th anniversary, and it is bigger than ever!

sections.title: Overview
items: January 8th, 2021

sections.title: Attack of the Anti-Monitor 10th Anniversary Event
items: The anniversary event is back this year for our 10th anniversary, and it is bigger than ever!

sections.title: New Event Raid and Elite Raid: Speed Force Flux
items: This year, things have changed. The vindictive Anti-Monitor is trying to free himself using one of the Multiverse’s most powerful and destructive paradoxes. Even if we win, will this new Flashpoint world prove too much for The Flash and Professor Zoom?
Open your On Duty menu and queue for " Speed Force Flux" or "Speed Force Flux Elite" under the events tab. The elite version is a full end-game difficulty raid.

sections.title: New Open World Missions
items: Revisit an updated Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone for brand-new daily, weekly, and bounty missions created just for this year's 10th Anniversary Event!
Open your Mission Journal and look for " Monitoring the Situation," or use the Warp Menu to go directly to the Metropolis Anti-Matter Invasion Zone.

sections.title: New 10th Anniversary Rewards
items: Unlock new styles inspired by The Flash and Professor Zoom.
Earn scaling gear based on your character's Combat Rating up to Item Level 270.
Members and Long Live The Legion owners will earn scaling gear up to Item Level 283 in the Elite Raid.
Earn Qwardian Crowns (anniversary currency) to use at the anniversary vendor.

Members and Episode owners will additionally earn Lex Coins ( Birds of Prey), Splintered Coins ( Wonderverse), or Solar Credits (Long Live The Legion) in the new raid, determined by your character's Combat Rating.
Earn Elite Commendations from prior Episodes when successful in the Elite Raid.
Collect new Boss Triumph Statues (base items) from DCUO's most challenging foes from the last 10 years.
Plus, look for new base items, Henchmen, feats, and more!

sections.title: Years Past
items: Of course, classic content from previous years is back, too. Open your On Duty menu to queue up for " Centennial Collapse" to get started. Plus, look for reduced costs on rewards from prior anniversaries!
And remember, our 10-year anniversary is January 11, 2021, so make sure to stop by again for gifts and more!

sections.title: Power
items: Atomic - Particle Beam - Fixed a bug where this ability could hit from a much further distance than intended.

sections.title: Affinities
items: Resolved an issue where elite affinities would incorrectly stop working after equipping more than 8 pieces of elite gear and then un-equipping pieces.

sections.title: Marketplace
items: Vault Tickets now list their level requirement.

sections.title: Episode 39: Long Live the Legion
items: The Time Bubble malfunction in the Hall of Doom has been rectified.
Exploit fix for re-entering the Mordru fight.
Further resolved issues with certain abilities being unable to hit Mordru.

sections.title: Episode 35: Metal Pt. I
items: Scarlet Speedster - Fixed issue where Red Death would teleport above the ceiling.

sections.title: Known Issues
items: The Ultraman Statue is missing its cape.
The Paradox Kraken’s hit box is too low.
The Paradox Kraken will sometimes T-Pose when certain attacks hit it.

title: Game Update 11
summary: New teleporters have been added outside the boss fights for Duos. This will allow players an extra 15 seconds to enter the boss fights after the boss fight door closes.

sections.title: Overview
items: March 27, 2012

sections.title: DCUO Teleporters!
items: New teleporters have been added outside the boss fights for Duos. This will allow players an extra 15 seconds to enter the boss fights after the boss fight door closes.

sections.title: Area 51
items: The quest objectives have undergone formatting changes.

sections.title: Arkham Asylum
items: Players no longer remain in combat once they make their way past the catwalks in the Mister Freeze Wing.

sections.title: H.I.V.E. Moon Base
items: Fixed the combat log to display correctly for the Drill Beam.

sections.title: Smallville
items: The correct amount of treasure chests will now spawn, and should now always drop loot.

sections.title: South Gotham Courthouse
items: The Duration of the Damaging Testimony field has been greatly reduced.
The Damage from the Damaging Testimony field has been delayed by 2 seconds to allow time to move out of it.
The surviving Attorney will now do much more damage during 'Closing Arguments'.

sections.title: Audio
items: Added an additional piece of music to the player dueling playlist.
Psychosomatic Illness
Fixed an issue where Dr. Psycho's dialog would play over the illusionary Wonder Woman and Super Girl's taunts.

sections.title: Metropolis
items: The Content Area Pointers for Kid Flash, Starfire and Weather Wizard have been updated and will no longer send you out into the sea to find them.

sections.title: Gotham
items: The Content Area Pointer for Clayface has been updated and will now send you to the proper area to find him.

sections.title: Collections
items: The icons for the South Gotham Collections should now appear properly.

sections.title: Combat
items: The Block counter effect should now only trigger in response to attacks which are Vulnerable to Block.

sections.title: Gorilla Grodd's Lab
items: Players will no longer spawn inside a book shelf when first entering Grodd's Lab.

sections.title: Feats
items: Resolved an issue with the feat Duos Dynamo that was granting it extra counts for completing certain duos.

sections.title: Items
items: The Lightning Strikes Ring Compartment Controller trinket should no longer apply its stat buff when the trinket is drained.
Healer items earned from Battle for Earth content have had their stats adjusted to offer more Restoration and less of other secondary stats.

sections.title: Missions
items: Beat the Heat
The Freeze Agent quest giver will no longer jump off of the roof and should be easier to find.
Communication Breakdown
The cars, vans, and traffic cones around the area should no longer be targetable during combat.
Exobyte Eclipse
Fixed an issue that could cause NPCs to appear to slide when first attacked.
Falling STARs
The quest objectives have undergone formatting changes.
Lunar Eclipse
Villain: Lightkeeper Janis should now stay down when you defeat her and not get up (reset) looking for a second beating.
Raven Unleashed
The Science Police no longer use their stealth rockets out in the open as this weapon is still under development. Enemies of the Science Police will now see rockets barreling toward them.
Reign of Blood
Players no longer remain in combat with Doctor Fate after defeating him.
Villain
Fixed an issue where players could get attacked by invulnerable NPCs if they backtracked through the instance after wiping.
Smash and Grab
The Gotham Police Cars in this area no longer have a protective coating that makes them indestructible.

sections.title: Electricity
items: Tesla Ball will now apply the Electrified power interaction even if the target is not stunned.
Repulse, Static Push, and Circuit Breaker will apply the Polarization power interaction even if the target is not knocked down.
Bio-Capacitor will now apply to you and 3 other group members properly.

sections.title: Earth
items: Changed the wording on Earthquake and Meteor Shower to indicate more about the effects of using these abilities.
All attack movement mode powers, such as Whirlwind Attack, now give the proper : Damage Absorption and Defense/ Toughness bonus for Earth power characters.

sections.title: Iconic Powers
items: Reduced the channel duration of Heat Vision and increased the damage inflicted per second.
Heat Vision and Freezing Breath will now play visual impact effects when hitting targets.

sections.title: Gadgets
items: Pets now persist through zoning.

sections.title: Light
items: The trait tree description text should be visible when mousing over or selecting the mastery tree box for both the Assault and Support trees.

sections.title: Nature
items: Primal Wolf Form “Slam” attack should no longer inflict a counter attack versus a target who is Vulnerable to Block.

sections.title: Sorcery
items: For the purposes of clarity, the box formerly known as Circle of Protection in the Destiny tree is now known as Circle of Destiny. This grants Circle of Destruction in Damage role and Circle of Protection in Healer role. The functionality and statistics of these abilities remain unchanged.

sections.title: PVP
items: All counter-attacks now inflict knockdown.
Corrected an issue that could occasionally cause you to have to break out after being hit with a counter attack if you wanted to begin moving right away.
Corrected an issue that could prevent block from working immediately after recovering from a counter attack.

sections.title: Legends
items: The Legends PvP trinket may no longer be used while in stealth.
Charge up attacks when released early will cause less damage than fully charged ones.
Damage caused by tray powers should no longer vary with the level of the player while in Legends matches.
Pets summoned by players under level 30 will now have the proper level 30 combat stats.

sections.title: Catwoman
items: Her Whip Pull attack no longer affects friendly targets.
Corrected a visual effects issue that would occur when she used her Smoke Cloud ability.
Her weapon combo abilities now inflict damage commensurate to other Legends characters.

sections.title: Fortress of Solitude: Zod's Revenge
items: Fixed an issue where Superman and Lex Luthor would refuse to 'shoot first' when threatened by Ursa and Zod. The two will now push themselves to be Heroic and assist the raid group in defeating Zod and his followers.

sections.title: Battle for Earth: Prime Battleground
items: Healer Drones should now properly de-spawn once Brainiac Prime is defeated.

sections.title: User Interface
items: On Duty UI
"Ready" check box now remains disabled until actually needed.
Trade UI
Removed chat window spam when items are added or removed.
Partners in Crime
Now correctly displays as a Duo rather than an Alert in the Mission Journal.
Ferris Aircraft (Duo)
Now correctly displays as a Duo rather than an Alert in the Mission Journal.
The Demon Inside
Bulletins will now update properly.
HUD Ability Tray
The cooldown and out-of-power icons now have improved readability.

sections.title: Visual
items: Made a number of environment fixes throughout the game world.

sections.title: Dual Wield
items: The animation speed of Dual Wield Phantom Slash (the ranged Tap) was decreased.The final combo hit of Whirlwind Overstrike, Stunning Swipe and Dual Flurry will now scale properly based on the total time of the tap attacks leading up to the final hold.

title: Game Update 111
summary: Queue up for Titan’s Training Sim in the Events tab to challenge yourself against the most difficult battles DCUO has ever seen. 30 rounds of challenge await, if you can survive. Each round consists of two waves of minions and one boss at the end of the waves.

sections.title: Overview
items: March 11, 2021

sections.title: Survival Mode Season 2
items: Queue up for Titan’s Training Sim in the Events tab to challenge yourself against the most difficult battles DCUO has ever seen. 30 rounds of challenge await, if you can survive. Each round consists of two waves of minions and one boss at the end of the waves.

Earn Materials, Auras, Base Items, Styles, Orbitals, and Pets. Earn Data Chips after defeating each boss. Every 5 rounds will increase the amount of Data Chips awarded from bosses. This currency can be used at both the Survival Mode Vendor and the Survival Mode Season Vendor for rewards.
Requirements:; 4 Players; Minimum CR: 310; Recommended CR: 316

sections.title: New in the Marketplace: Data Chips!
items: Data Chips from Survival Mode are now available in the Marketplace like other seasonal currencies.

Note: Many Survival Mode rewards require your character to have advanced through a certain round. Even if you have or purchase enough Data Chips, you still must have advanced through that round to obtain the item.

sections.title: New in the Marketplace: Anti-Matter Neon Chroma Pack
items: If you missed this year's 10th Anniversary member gifts and you are regretting all of your choices in life as you stare longingly at your friends sporting the Anti-Matter Neon Chroma Pack, you're in luck. The the pack is now available in the Marketplace.

sections.title: St. Patrick's Day Seasonal Event
items: Mister Mxyzptlk is back this year to taunt Metropolis with his riches! Look for “ Mxyleprechauns!” in your Mission Journal, and speak to Mister Mxyzptlk in your HQ.
New Feats!; Watt’s the big ID-Ear; Just Another Brick in the Wall
For 2021, Mister Mxyzptlk has new Base and style items! Start now before your luck runs out! Level Requirement: 15

sections.title: Pets
items: Combat Trinket Pets and Turrets have been improved and normalized. This opens the way for introducing new systems for these pets in the future.
Combat Pet Projectiles no longer have a chance to fire more than once per attack but have had their damage increased and will no longer split damage between targets.
Combat Pet Ranged Attacks fire much more often now and have had their per hit damage reduced to compensate but overall damage has increased on average.

Combat Pets now are balanced to be within the same damage and hit range of each other. These pets include:; Vampire Bat; Shadow Bat; Dark Construct Bat; Brainiac Drone; Paradox Gazer; Father Box; Mother Box; Seahorse
Combat Single Target Turrets generally do more damage now as a whole. These turrets include:; Green Crystal Turret; Anti-Matter Turret
Combat AoE Turrets have had their range slightly increased and generally do more damage now as a whole. These turrets include:; Snake Turret; Shadow Snake Turret
Survival Mode Combat Pets and Turrets will do increased damage within Survival Mode.

sections.title: Character Creation
items: English language should no longer play on top of Localized language during the Character Creation movie

sections.title: Mini-Map
items: Minimap icons can now change during an encounter

sections.title: Suicide Squad/Task Force X Changes
items: Collar FX should play once and only once on the characters of the Opposing Team
Characters that are playing on a combined faction team (either Suicide Squad or Task Force X) for the very first time, will still receive the communicator audio message as normal

Characters that are playing on a combined faction team for the second time and beyond will see a text based UMS near the side of the screen; The UMS has no buttons and should not steal input focus from the game. The player should be able to play the game normally while the UMS is up.; The UMS is on a timer and will close itself when the specified time has elapsed.

title: Game Update 113
summary: Spring is in the air! Poison Ivy is back to wreak havoc on the people of Gotham City! We’ve added four new Feats, new bee-themed Base items, chromas and style items.

sections.title: Spring Seasonal Event
items: Spring is in the air! Poison Ivy is back to wreak havoc on the people of Gotham City! We’ve added four new Feats, new bee-themed Base items, chromas and style items.
Collect Seed Pods and purchase Spring items from “ Arborist Louis” next to Swamp Thing in the Watchtower or “ The Misgiving Tree” next to Poison Ivy in the Hall of Doom.

Villains can learn more about Poison Ivy’s plans by speaking to her in the Hall of Doom’s Pit, while Heroes can speak to Swamp Thing in the Watchtower’s Aquacultural Area to help bring down Ivy and her minions. Speak to Veronica Cale (Villains) or Doctor Sarah Charles (Heroes) to find out more about taking on Swamp Thing.
Level Requirement: 10
New Feats!
Leader of the Swarm
Buzz About Town
Just Bee Yourself
Building a Hive

sections.title: Known Issue
items: The base items Honeycomb Hive Flooring A and B state incorrectly in their tooltip that they can be added to the style tab.

sections.title: FP: Flash to the Future
items: Fixed an issue where Brainiac did not animate when doing his Furnace Blast.

sections.title: FP: Flashtastic Voyage
items: Adjusted to the Gorilla Grodd fight mechanic that ejects players out of the Eradication Platform rooms to resolve issue where players would experience camera weirdness and be unable to escape attacks for a few seconds after being warped.

sections.title: Chat
items: The message shown when you unlock a Rally Point is now shown as a Notification and in the chat window.
The message shown when entering Player Housing is now shown in the chat window.

sections.title: UI
items: Fixed a bug where Group Members were not being shown on the Map.

sections.title: Artifacts
items: Pied Pipers Flute: Greatly reduced chance of Pied Pipers Flute not activating at rank 200
Circe's Mask: Resolved an issue where certain Shield abilities, such as Amazonian Deflection, would never proc the Circe's Mask artifact.
Circe's Mask: Resolved an issue where the Circe's Mask artifact could proc off of Shields you cast on others. It should only proc on Shields you cast on yourself.

sections.title: Atlantis: Palace
items: Added failsafes to try and prevent issues where the Crown of Thorns would skip ahead, particularly if players opted to skip the cameras.

sections.title: Central City
items: "Can't Stop" / "The Run Down" missions should now be complete-able again. Players should be getting the speedster buff when they approach Flash or Zoom while doing one of these missions, even if they were form-changed already (like in Nature Gorilla form)

sections.title: War-Torn Village
items: Bounties now respawn every 2 minutes instead of 12 minutes

sections.title: Gotham Under Siege
items: Tour of Duty Mission: Wayward Soldier should no longer get stuck trying to interact with the barrel.

sections.title: God of Monsters
items: Forming a Lightning Chain to blast Typhon should work much more reliably.

sections.title: Vendors
items: Fixed an issue where the Birds of Prey vendor was selling Justice League Dark Adaptive Augment Catalysts

title: Game Update 114
summary: The battle for the throne of Atlantis continues! Ocean Master, Aquaman's conniving half-brother, has rallied a force of mutineer Atlanteans in an attempt to displace King Arthur and take the throne! The Atlantean civil war has breached the waters of Metropolis.

sections.title: Overview
items: June 9, 2021

sections.title: The Tides of War Summer Seasonal Event
items: The battle for the throne of Atlantis continues! Ocean Master, Aquaman's conniving half-brother, has rallied a force of mutineer Atlanteans in an attempt to displace King Arthur and take the throne! The Atlantean civil war has breached the waters of Metropolis.

Track Tides of War in your Mission Journal and check the Events tab in the On Duty menu to battle for the Atlantean Outpost. Or alternatively you can now use the Warp Menu to head directly to the Open World Content by selecting Summer Seasonal: Ocean Master. Fight for your side, and reap new rewards including new feats!

sections.title: New Feats
items: Backyard Master
True King of the Grill
The Pineapple Express

In celebration of our Summer Event this year, we have added new collections, new base items, hot new backyard grilling styles, and a refreshing new chroma to help you cool off when the fight heats up! Level Requirement: 10

sections.title: Sixth Dimension Kryptonian Time Capsule
items: The Sixth Dimension Kryptonian Time Capsule contains amazing new styles and items inspired by Sixth Dimension Superman including:
A new gear suit inspired by Sixth Dimension Superman
Collection Items: Kryptonian Kerchief Accessory, Freedom Mullet, and Super Rebellious Jacket
Kryptonian-Inspired Emblems
The Dimensional Chroma Pack
Plus, open 15 capsules to receive the Superman Doll Accessory

You can find locked Time Capsules by defeating enemies. Open Time Capsules with Stabilizers earned in-game or available on the Marketplace. Unlocked Sixth Dimension Kryptonian Time Capsules are also available on the Marketplace.

sections.title: Celebrate Pride
items: The DCUO Team is happy to celebrate Pride Month with these free gifts! Express your pride or show your support with Progress Pride Flag, Pride Flag, Pride Cape, Pride love Emblem, DC Pride Logo Emblem & Enhanced DC Pride Logo Emblem.

title: Game Update 117
summary: All hell has broken loose in the streets of Gotham City and inside The Midnight Masquerade Nightclub.

sections.title: Overview
items: October 7, 2021

sections.title: The Witching Hour Returns with new Base Items, Feats, and Styles
items: All hell has broken loose in the streets of Gotham City and inside The Midnight Masquerade Nightclub.
Go to the House of Legends and speak to the Phantom Stranger (Heroes) or to Tala (Villains) to receive further instructions.
To queue for The Midnight Masquerade, go into your On Duty UI and look under the Events Tab.

sections.title: New Race
items: Travel to the House of Legends and take flight in the new Multiplayer Aerial Movement Challenge: Flapping in the Night.
You’ll be transformed into a vampire bat to race around Arkham Asylum.
Earn new rewards and feats for achieving platinum, gold, and silver tiers.
There are also new feats and new collections to be found for those brave enough:
Blinding Speed
One Fast Bat
Supersonic Wings
Flying Rats?
Authority of the Hunt
Lair of the Night Creatures
Each day of the event, also look for The Witching Hour in your Mission Journal to complete and earn Spooky Bites!
Shop using Teekl’s Halloween bucket for the latest in scare-wear, tricks, treats, and creepy items for your Base.
You’ll even find a few extra special surprises, like the new Man-Bat inspired style items, the Spooky Bats Chroma Pack, and the Demon Bat Accessory.
Level Requirement: 10

references.label: Multiplayer Aerial Movement Challenge: Flapping in the Night

sections.title: Fall Vault
items: The fall vault is back! Everyone can run the vault daily during The Witching Hour event.
Find the Vault-O'-Lantern in the House of Legends for a special new mission that treats you with access to this themed vault.

sections.title: Fall Fest
items: And don't miss Fall Fest. Log in to claim your free gifts or take advantage of this most horrifying sale.

sections.title: On Duty Menu
items: Quickplay buttons will no longer flash between Pressed and Rest state on when using mouse and keyboard, when holding the mouse down near the edge of the button
Increased the font size for group member names
Now displays the Deserter Penalty timeout
Replay Badges are now labeled as such
Now only shows one role choice when the player has not yet unlocked their second role

sections.title: Save the Universe

Solitary Riot no longer offers choice of 9 identical gear pieces

sections.title: House of Legends
items: Batsignal mission - Oracle no longer says to go to the Watchtower in her comm
Last Laugh mission: Calculator no longer says to go to the Hall of Doom in his comm

sections.title: Bases
items: Added vendor categories to the base Dispenser
Armories now correctly display mannequins in the Manor Lair
The base item limit for lairs has been increased from 600 to 700
The Manor Lair's secret door now has additional collision to prevent it being placed outside the map

sections.title: Accessories
items: Runic Hand Accessories are now account bound instead of no trade, keeping them consistent with their Aura variants

sections.title: Iconic Weapons
items: Rogues in the Brothers in Arms operation can now drop iconic weapons
The following weapons have been added:; Captain Cold's Dual Pistols; Kalibak's Beta-Rod; Two-Face's Tommy Gun; Joker's Golf Club; Captain Boomerang’s Boomerangs

sections.title: Allies
items: Most Allies are no longer attackable by NPCs, to prevent them from being Crowd Controlled on occasion; Flashpoint Wonder Woman remains attackable due to the nature of her combat ability
Most Allies will now blink closer to the most recent hate target of the player if they deem themselves too far away.
Known Issue: Ally ability descriptions have not been updated and will be in an upcoming hotfix.

sections.title: Calculator Bot
items: Passive 01 buff heal buffed to 6/8/10% hp back

sections.title: HoL-Bot
items: Power Thief (passive) will now have a 30 second cooldown at all Ally Levels

sections.title: Emperor Aquaman
items: Hear My Call; Upon the player taking damage, increases baseline DPS for all currently summoned Pets, excluding Allies and Combat Turret Trinket pets; At max affinity level pets do 10% more damage. This lasts for 20 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown.; Rank 6: Pets do 5% more damage; Rank 7: Pets do 6% more damage; Rank 8: Pets do 7% more damage; Rank 9: Pets do 8% more damage; Rank 10: Pets do 10% more damage; Known Issue – pets summoned after the proc has triggered, within that proc window, do not get the DPS buff. This will be corrected in a future hotfix.

sections.title: Flashpoint Batman
items: Sole Detective will now apply while solo at 100% potency and in groups at 33% potency (instead of only applying while solo)

Changed Combat Suture's percent-of-precision heal to a simpler flat percentage of your health heal:; Rank 6 = 5% hp; Rank 7 = 6% hp; Rank 8 = 7% hp; Rank 9 = 8% hp; Rank 10 = 10% hp
Changed Combat Suture's cooldown:; Rank 6 = 30 seconds; Rank 7 = 26 seconds; Rank 8 = 22 seconds; Rank 9 = 18 seconds; Rank 10 = 12 seconds

sections.title: Queen Diana

sections.title: Zoom
items: Disabled his passive from activating while in a race

sections.title: Pets

summary: Purchases of any Ally from the Marketplace made before their transition to account-wide have been placed in the Redeem/Claim Marketplace menu, and can now be claimed on all characters on your account.

items: November 4, 2021

items: Purchases of any Ally from the Marketplace made before their transition to account-wide have been placed in the Redeem/Claim Marketplace menu, and can now be claimed on all characters on your account.
Purchases of the same Ally from the Marketplace on more than one character, made before their transition to account-wide, have been refunded to your wallets (in Daybreak Cash or Marketplace Cash).

sections.title: Ally

Daily Rewards: The last couple of daily reward days that may have previously been inaccessible should now be viewable

Players who are being scaled down and use Omnibus will benefit more from the Early End Game Buff than those who Custom Play; Players who are being scaled down and use Custom Play will benefit fully from the Early End Game Buff IF at least half of the group is being scaled up
Players being scaled up in On Duty content will benefit from a damage buff in 2 player, 4 player, and 8 player content
Players being scaled up in On Duty content can block to heal if below 50% health; This is similar to the benefit provided by the Roleless Buff (when the group didn't have a healer)
Players in elite versions of content have increased stat piercing when scaled down

sections.title: Amazon Fury III

sections.title: Overview
items: April 18, 2012

sections.title: New Bank UI
items: We've improved the overall look and feel of our Bank UI. Along with better manageability and messaging, the Shared Bank is now located on its own tab. Players also now have the flexibility to split stacks of items within the Bank UI that they once only had within their Inventory. We've also included the ability to quick swap items into your Bank or Shared Bank! With one click (right mouse button) you can instantly move items over without the need to pick items up and drag them to an empty space.

sections.title: Purchase Character Slots in Character Select
items: Want to create your Alter Ego? Now you can! Players now have the ability to add new character slots right in Character Select! The “Add Character Slots” button is located below the Character List on the Character Selection Screen.

sections.title: Alert Teleporters
items: We have added teleporters outside the boss fights for Alerts, where applicable, to allow players an extra 15 seconds to enter the boss fights after the boss fight door closes.

sections.title: Ace Chemicals
items: Fixed an issue where it was possible to get stuck in the treasure rooms.

sections.title: Audio
items: Full House now plays combat music when you engage him in Amusement Mile.
Raven Unbound : This playroom has improved Music.
Bizarro, Minotaur and Solomon Grundy Open World Encounters now play combat music when you engage them.

sections.title: Duos
items: South Gotham entrances to the Duos are now properly limited to level 30 characters.

sections.title: General
items: Sparring Dummies in the Hall of Doom and Watchtower will no longer keep the players in combat. Really, we mean it this time.
Players with saved settings will no longer experience the game resetting to default settings upon login.
Fixed a bug where binding a key wouldn't always have the intended result.
Mail no longer indicates there are attachments when none actually exist.

sections.title: Items
items: The Soder Cola Enhancer Type IV now has a max stack size of 16.

sections.title: Missions
items: Goddess of Peril: Villain and Lair of the Witch: Hero Missions no longer need to be active in order to enter their respective playroom. Riddle Me This
Fixed an issue where Heroes could receive damage during a cool cam.
WANTED: Abra Kadabra
This bounty mission now correctly recognizes you are in Central City.
Gorge Yourself
Villain: Gluttony Obelisks are no longer greedy and will update your quest upon arrival.
Old Gotham Subway
You must be Level 30 to enter the Old Gotham Subway Challenge Mode Teleporter.

sections.title: Powers
items: Movement
The power regeneration triggered by Breakout Mastery and related Movement power traits now tick more slowly for larger chunks. The amount of power returned over time is unchanged.

sections.title: PVP
items: Fixed an issue that caused revive bars to display progress incorrectly.
Critical effects are reduced while in PvP arena zones.
PvP weapon Precision bonuses will always be present when you are in PvP arena zone and won't require hitting an enemy player first.

sections.title: Legends
items: Bane will no longer lose the Venom Clap ability after pumping up with venom twice and reaching his maximum strength.
All Legends characters now come equipped with the Breakout Mastery trait, allowing for gradual power recovery following the use of the Breakout ability.
Joker's Confetti Bomb now uses a faster animation without a cast time.

sections.title: Kahndaq
items: Black Adam has decided to even the odds and allow players to be the first to attack him. He will now wait at the center of the room for worthy opponents to try their hand at defeating him.

sections.title: Prime Battleground
items: Brainiac has updated his source code to ensure he receives Healer Drones during the final sequence. Prepare to be assimilated!

sections.title: Themyscira: The Gates of Tartarus
items: Fixed an issue where Wonder Woman and Circe would become fear-stricken and refuse to continue.
The Avatar of Magic has weakened, is no longer considered immortal and should always fall in battle if stripped of all life.

sections.title: South Gotham
items: Sub-Avatars:
Brainiac has reconfigured his construction pads in an effort to increase Sub-Avatar production, raising the threat in South Gotham .

sections.title: Bank
items: Added better messaging when item trading or deleting is not available.
Pressing X on a gamepad or right clicking on an item will now move it from the Bank to Inventory or vice versa.

sections.title: Broker
items: Deposit and price cash fields are now formatted with commas to improve readability.
Improved messaging in the Broker UI when you do not have enough cash to cover the Auction deposit price.

sections.title: Inventory
items: The currency tab will now update properly if Marks are acquired while the inventory UI is open.

sections.title: On Duty
items: Added "[LOCKED]" messaging for unavailable Legends PvP characters.
The “required time” section of the completed race UI is no longer displayed when finishing a race in Platinum time.
Scrolling of text description on Collections has been added.
Quest objectives in the Mission Journal HUD element are now displayed in the same order as in the Quest Journal.

sections.title: Chat
items: Players can now type /help in the chat window for a list of slash commands.
Custom Chat channels now show the correct channel name when talking into the channel.

sections.title: Visual
items: Fixed a number of environmental issues throughout the world.

title: Game Update 121
summary: Enter the Tunnel of Love in 2022 with new Base Items, Feats and Styles!

sections.title: Overview
items: February 10, 2022

sections.title: Valentine's Day Seasonal Event: Love Conquers All
items: Enter the Tunnel of Love in 2022 with new Base Items, Feats and Styles!

The Star Sapphires are again making an effort to rekindle the love lost in Gotham City. Mister Freeze knows what the Zamaron crystals are capable of and has hatched a plan to bring his wife Nora back by integrating their crystals into his cryogenic technology. This misuse of the crystals is extremely dangerous and could cause an exothermic reaction that would destroy the entire city! Check the Events tab in the On Duty menu for “ Love’s Battlefield” to aid the Star Sapphires (Heroes) or Mister Freeze (Villains).
New Feats!
Show Your Passion
Shards of Love
Prom Royalty

Open your map and choose the Love is in the Air destination. Speak to Hal Jordan (Heroes) or Mister Freeze (Villains) in the House of Legends. While in the House of Legends, visit the heart next to Hal Jordan or the frozen heart next to Mister Freeze to pick up a Daily Valentine’s Race mission “ Get Your Heart Racing”. This mission can also be picked up at a terminal in Northeast Metropolis near Union Station.

Also make sure to speak with Mera, who is spending Valentine’s Day on dryland apart from her dearest love. Open your Mission Journal and track “ Sea of Love” to find her! And don’t forget to visit the Valentine’s Vendor to get seasonal clothing, candies, and base items!

Abilities with a cast time will now consume power/supercharge when the ability is used, as the cast time begins rather than after.

sections.title: Taskbar Flashing (PC Only)

You receive a tell.

title: Game Update 13
summary: Poison Ivy is back to wreak havoc on the people of Gotham's allergies... only it's much worse than that. Luckily for the innocents, Swamp Thing has returned to help thwart Poison Ivy's plans. Villains can learn more about Poison Ivy’s plans by speaking to her in the Hall of Doom’s Pit, while Heroes can speak to Swamp thing in the Watchtower’s Aquacultural Area to help bring down Ivy and her...

sections.title: Spring is in the air
items: Poison Ivy is back to wreak havoc on the people of Gotham's allergies... only it's much worse than that. Luckily for the innocents, Swamp Thing has returned to help thwart Poison Ivy's plans. Villains can learn more about Poison Ivy’s plans by speaking to her in the Hall of Doom’s Pit, while Heroes can speak to Swamp thing in the Watchtower’s Aquacultural Area to help bring down Ivy and her minions.

sections.title: Tokens of Merit
items: Tokens of Merit vendors are now available and can be found in the Watchtower War Room and the Hall of Doom Pit areas. Players can purchase Tokens of Merit with all existing Marks and Seasonal Currencies. The Tokens of Merit can be consumed to gain new Tokens of Merit Feats, which means more skill points to make you a more powerful force in the DC Universe!

sections.title: DCUO Raid Teleporters
items: We have added teleporters outside the boss fights for Raids , where applicable, to allow players an extra 15 seconds to enter the boss fights after the door closes.

sections.title: Purchasing the DLC just got easier
items: Players can now purchase any DLC content they do not have by selecting it during character create in the Inspired By section or by selecting a Power they do not have access to yet!

sections.title: Collections Update
items: Listen Up! We’ve updated our Collections system to give players an enriched experience with Investigations and Briefs! We’ve added new audio effects to the voice recordings of Collections to exhibit the source of the recording; from CB radio, to TV, to Satellite, even magically transmitted recordings! There is also a new UI element to reflect the newly processed transmission with special icons in the Communicator window. We will be adding more enhanced audio to our Collections in future updates, so keep your ears open!

sections.title: Area 51
items: Defeating the Prime Servitor in Area 51 on normal difficulty will no longer show a loot lock for the Hard Mode Alert. Exit Locations are now properly labeled on the Map and Minimap UI.

sections.title: Bludhaven
items: New advances in toxins ensure pools spilling from Toxic Chemical barrels will only cause chemical burns to enemies.

sections.title: S.T.A.R. Labs
items: Players will now receive a Mission Objective message when the Alert is complete directing them to exit S.T.A.R. Labs.

sections.title: Audio
items: The Voice Over in DC Universe Online now has a priority system! Voice Over will now play without stacking up, so you can hear Iconic communicator messaging without being interrupted by vendor or collections Voice Over.

sections.title: Marks
items: All “Marks” earned through PvE, PvP and Seasonal Content are now capped at 250. If you have 250 or more marks stored on your character, the number in the currencies tab will appear in red. You will be unable to earn more marks of that type until you reduce the number to below the cap.

sections.title: Gotham Hospital
items: Guardian MK-IV’s shotgun attack has been adjusted to spread the damage more evenly between melee and ranged targets. Melee range targets will see reduced damage from this attack, while ranged targets will have more to actively avoid.
Turrets during the boss encounter have had their damage reduced, and will now choose more random targets.

sections.title: Gotham University
items: When defeated, Isis has agreed to always return to dust and bone.

sections.title: Riverfront Center
items: Guardian MK-XXII’s Healer drones now have a 3 second gap between appearing, instead of all 3 at the same time.

sections.title: Feats
items: Assembly Line and Entering Mass Production now award the correct amount of feat points when completed.

sections.title: General
items: The Tap Room now has a proper Rally Point.
Target Dummies now regain full health when dropping below 10% health.
Target Dummies now return power to players during their training.
The tour cam in the Hall of Doom has been updated to show off the new Pit area.
Players will no longer sometimes lose control of their camera when being interrupted as they are starting an interaction such as a collection.

sections.title: Missions
items: Blind Eye
Players will now see the Entrance to the playroom without having the quest actively tracked in their Journal.
Saving the Souls of Students (Hero) and Coed Chomping (Villain)
Etrigan's spell will now properly convert you into a Zombie.
T.O. Trap
T.O. Morrow has agreed to let players enter the room and not be locked out of the room left to watch Batman and Joker face off.
Batman will now remember to bring his loot list with him to the fight. Villains that are victorious should now receive goodies when defeating Batman in T.O. Morrow's Lab.

sections.title: Earth
items: Debris Field, Shards, Striking Stones, Pebble Blast, Localized Tremor and Jackhammer will no longer remove the Dazed and/or Crushed power interactions when used.
Upheaval and Jackhammer will now give you 50% Damage Absorption for 12 seconds from Aftershocks unless Damage Shift is active

sections.title: Fire
items: Flame Cascade and Fireburst should now perform their Power interactions correctly, dealing additional damage to Burning, Electrified, or Frostbitten targets.

sections.title: Gadgets
items: Cryo-Foam will now continue its damage after the root ends; The Burning interaction to electrified targets will now be applied even if the target is immune to knockdown.
Hide is now usable while controlled.
Cryo-Foam should now perform its Power interaction correctly, inflicting Burning on Electrified targets.

Fear Gas should now perform its Power interaction correctly, inflicting Burning on Electrified targets, causing Burning or Electrified targets to explode, and occasionally encasing Frostbitten targets.

sections.title: Nature
items: Primal Wolf Form melee hold attack, Slam, now Interrupts as intended, rather than being a Block Breaker.

sections.title: Sorcery
items: Transmutation should now deal additional damage to encased and polymorphed enemies.
The description for Sacrificial Offering has been updated to make it clear that your Red Soul Aura is consumed when using this ability.

sections.title: PVP
items: Counter Attack Immunity: Performing a successful Block Break, Interrupt or Block Counter will now grant you a short respite during which you cannot be damaged, controlled or counter-attacked. Counter Attack Immunity will be indicated by a blue flash, instead of the normal white breakout flash.
PvP weapons no longer de-buff an opponent’s Toughness.
Blue quality level 30 PvP starter weapons now add a Precision bonus when used in PvP to give them an effective DPS value of 87.5 when used against players.
PvP armor no longer has the Defense stat

PvP armor now offers less Toughness and more Health. Tank armor has more Toughness than non-Tank armor. Toughness values have been generally reduced overall, but survivability when wearing PvP armor has been increased due to the Health increase.

Tankanti-controller de-buff protection and group Breakout effects now last three seconds and may only be applied a maximum of twice every 12 seconds. This affects the following abilities:; Earth: Unstoppable and Crystal’s De-buff Protection; Fire: Burning Determination and Burnout; Ice: Winter Ward and Shatter Restraints.

Controllerhealing de-buff powers now also strip normal power over time effects applied by controllers. This affects the following abilities:; Pyrokinesis, Horrific Visage, Cryo-Foam, Bomb and Snap Trap.

sections.title: Legends
items: Increased the damage of a minimally charged Batarang Flurry for Batman and Robin.

sections.title: Raids

General Zod, Superman and Lex Luthor will no longer flee from battle when traveling through the halls of the Fortress of Solitude.
Kahndaq Waterkeepers are now vulnerable to all damage sources.

sections.title: Overview
items: February 25th, 2025

Get ready! Campaign 2025 is here, bringing a year-long adventure packed with thrilling events, exclusive rewards, and more! This campaign consists of four Patrol Events that will contribute to your overall campaign progress. Players completing the minimum requirements for each of the Patrols will also earn a choice of Campaign 2025 Mega Rewards. For players entering the campaign later in the year, buyouts for previous Patrols will be available.

sections.title: Campaign 2025 Mega Rewards
items: Upon completion of Campaign 2025, you’ll be able to choose from the following:

sections.title: Wolf Pack Token
items: Use this currency to purchase Account Bound Artifacts from the Artifact Vendor. This currency is shared by all characters on your account.

sections.title: Shaded Comic Material
items: Transform your look with the Shaded Comic Material. This fully customizable material features three adjustable channels controlled by your color palette. Use it to give your equipped styles an eye-catching appearance that will turn heads.

Superb Nth Metal
Seal of Completion x6
Paradox Energy x15
Quantum Field Energy x21
Dionesium x29

Ally Favor x100000
Legendary Alliance x20
Epic Alliance x35
Rare Alliance x40

sections.title: First Patrol Event: Shock to the System
items: Dakota City is in crisis, and only the bravest can rise to the challenge. Patrol 1: Shock to the System is the first of a four-part event campaign running from February 25 to March 24, calling on players to relive a past conflict that once shook the Milestone Universe. With heroes disappearing and danger escalating, Static and Rocket have sent out a distress call. Will you answer?

sections.title: Event Overview
items: Step into Dakota City and embark on thrilling challenges to uncover the mystery behind the vanishing heroes. As you battle through the event, you can earn the following exclusive rewards:
All-new Shadow Curse Iconic Ability (Fully Reclaimable)
Unleash the Shadow Curse on your target and blast them with shadow energy!
40 Pack of Kaznian Crowns (Once Per Account)
3x Perfected Nth Metal (Once Per Account)
Visit the Events menu to get started

sections.title: Limited-Time Sale: Fortify Tab Discounts!
items: From February 25 to March 3, take advantage of a 20% discount in the Fortify category in the Marketplace. Power up your artifacts and gear to prepare for the battles ahead.

sections.title: New Artifact: Candle of Neron
items: Do you crave more power? Candle of Neron is a potent new artifact that boosts your Critical Ability Attack Chance and grants access to the devastating Soul Signature ability. However, every deal with a demon comes with a price. Collect Soul Stacks through critical hits to ensure you come out ahead in this dark pact.

sections.title: Rank 80 Unlock

Consumes Soul Stacks to launch a necrotic fireball, dealing 13% Might damage to up to 8 targets within 10 meters.

This ability always critically hits.

April 29, 2025

The April 29th update brings a range of new content, improvements, and adjustments to enhance your gameplay experience. From the launch of Patrol 02: Justice League Dark Cursed to important changes in the Reward Reclaim system and visual upgrades on PC, this update continues to build on the momentum of Campaign 2025. Whether you're here for new rewards, performance improvements, or just staying current, here’s everything you need to know!

sections.title: Patrol 02: Justice League Dark Cursed
items: Patrol 02: Justice League Dark Cursed is NOW LIVE! This marks the next thrilling chapter of Campaign 2025, a year-long adventure packed with epic events, exclusive rewards, and more. The campaign features four Patrol Events in total, each contributing to your overall campaign progress. Complete the minimum requirements for each Patrol to earn your choice of Campaign 2025 Mega Rewards. As an added bonus, completing Patrol 2 gives you the chance to earn rewards like the new ally: John Constantine. If you're joining the campaign late, don’t worry, buyouts for previous Patrols are available to help you catch up.

sections.title: Second Patrol Event: Justice League Dark Cursed
items: Dark forces are stirring, and the magical world is under siege. Patrol 2: Justice League Dark Cursed begins April 29th and runs through May 27th, plunging players into a supernatural crisis unlike any before. A devastating curse is spreading rapidly among the world’s magic users, threatening to unravel reality itself. In a desperate move, John Constantine has relocated the House of Mystery to Gotham Cemetery, where he and Zatanna are calling for your help.

sections.title: New Ally: John Constantine
items: Step into the shadows with the legendary occult detective himself, John Constantine joins your roster as a powerful new ally, blending dark magic and tactical support to tip the scales in your favor.

sections.title: Ward of Zauriel
items: Constantine conjures a mystical Ward of Zauriel, surrounding himself in a protective zone that enhances allies and punishes enemies.
Allies within the ward receive bonus Defense, Might, and Precision.
Enemies inside take damage every second and non-boss foes are knocked back.
Power Interaction: Inflicts Bad Karma, leaving enemies vulnerable to karmic effects.

sections.title: Runic Recourse
items: When a Stat Buff Trinket is activated, Constantine provides an immediate tactical advantage:
Instant power return.
Bonus power regeneration.
Protective shield to absorb incoming damage.

sections.title: Zauriel’s Blessing (Healer Role Only)
items: When using a Healing Field, Constantine empowers the center of the field with a ward, granting all allies inside it the same potent buffs to Defense, Might, and Precision.
Master of the arcane and protector against the dark, John Constantine is the perfect ally for those looking to bring a touch of sorcery and strategy to the battlefield.

sections.title: Private Matchmaking
items: Looking for one more person to join and leave? Look no further, Private Matchmaking is here! Select Private Match in the Custom Play section of the On Duty menu to start an instance without matchmaking. The instance will start immediately with only the current members of your group. Note: This is an experimental feature, and all content may not function correctly for groups below the recommended number of players. PLAY AT YOUR OWN RISK!

sections.title: Reward Claim Menu Update
items: The Reward Reclaim page within the event menu has received an important update. Starting with the latest release, players will now only have the option to buy out non-patrol event rewards for up to 4 weeks after the event ends. Any events older than this will still be available for buyout until May 27th, offering players a limited window to claim rewards from previous events. Be sure to check the event menu regularly to ensure you don’t miss out on any rewards you want to claim!

sections.title: PC Platform Visual Update
items: The PC version of the game has received a visual update. The textures on PC have been aligned with the latest versions seen on console platforms, providing a more consistent experience across all platforms. This update will require an additional 4.5 GB of disk space to patch the game, so players should ensure they have enough storage available. This update is part of ongoing efforts to enhance the visual quality and performance of the game on PC.

sections.title: New Iconic Ability: Atlan Brine Hulk
items: Command the fury of the deep with the all-new Iconic Ability: Atlan Brine Hulk! This Supercharge ability lets you summon a monstrous Brine Hulk that erupts from the ocean floor, dealing heavy damage in a wide blast radius. This hulking beast will assault nearby enemies with brutal claw strikes and devastating water spray attacks for 20 seconds. With its wide reach and sustained pressure, this ability is perfect for turning the tide in your favor during large-scale battles.

sections.title: Summer Seasonal: Tides of War
items: The tides rise once more in Tides of War 2025; the battle for Atlantis is far from over! Ocean Master has returned with renewed ambition and an army of mutineer Atlanteans, determined to overthrow King Arthur and seize the throne. Their conflict has once again spilled into the waters off Metropolis, and it’s up to you to take a stand.

Collect Sand Dollars and visit the Atlantean Quartermaster or Mutineer Quartermaster in the House of Legends to trade them for this year’s newest Summer rewards, including Chroma Materials, Absolute Aquaman Power Styles, Base Items, Feats, and more!
Track Tides of War in your Mission Journal, queue up for the Atlantean Outpost Alert through the Summer Seasonal section in the On Duty Quickplay menu, or use the Warp Menu to dive straight in!
Note: Open world location is named differently depending on your faction. Heroes will see Tides of War: Aquaman, while Villains will see Tides of War: Ocean Master
Level Requirement: 20

sections.title: New Feats
items: Claw and Order - Grants "Tidebringer" title
Absolutely Fin-Credible
Aquatic Aristocracy
Deep Sea View

sections.title: New Vendor Items
items: Styles; Absolute Aquaman Pauldron Style (Legendary); Absolute Aquaman Cuirass Style (Legendary); Absolute Aquaman Gauntlet Style (Legendary); Undersea Monarch Chroma Pack (Legendary)
Base Items; Ocean View - Floor Window; Ocean View - Landscape Frame; Ocean View - Standing Window

sections.title: Pet Collision Update
items: The new Pet Collision Update removes physical collisions between you and your own pets, allies, and base-pets, so they’ll no longer block or interfere with your movement during gameplay. This update prevents pets from blocking your path, reduces frustrating pathing issues, improves combat fluidity, and movement in tight spaces.

sections.title: Broker Revamp
items: We’ve revamped the Broker to improve your buying and selling experience! Here’s what’s new:
Broker Fee Timing: Fees are now charged only when your item sells—not when you list it.
Longer Listings: Listing duration has been extended from 2 days to 14 days.
Clearer Time Displays: Time remaining now shows in days, hours, and minutes, with listing duration accurately reflected in the UI.
Price Input Enhancements: Maximum sale price increased to 999 billion, and prices now display commas for easier reading.
Smarter Sorting: Listings now default to sorting by lowest price first, helping you find the best deals faster.
These updates make trading on the Broker smoother, clearer, and more user-friendly for everyone!

sections.title: Xbox and PlayStation
items: At this time, players cannot change listing prices on the Broker due to a missing on-screen keyboard, and we are actively working on a resolution.

sections.title: Nintendo Switch Only
items: Switch users will be unable to select items in the Marketplace Cash or Time Capsules categories on the in-game Marketplace unless they first use the following workaround. When accessing these categories, there will be no visible selector highlighting items in the right-side pane where Marketplace bundles are listed. To view the Marketplace Cash or Time Capsules categories in-game:
First, select the Currency tab (or any tab listed below it).
Then choose your desired category.
Note: If you select the Featured or Bundles tabs, you’ll need to repeat this process to access Marketplace Cash or Time Capsules again.
Marketplace Cash can still be purchased through the Nintendo eShop:
Highlight DC Universe Online on your Home menu.
Press the + button and select Nintendo eShop.
Scroll down and choose DC Universe Online Marketplace Cash.

sections.title: Patrol 3: Brainiac Returns
items: Patrol 3: Brainiac Returns is launching July 29 and runs through August 25! This is the third of four installments in Campaign 2025, our year-long journey featuring four unique Patrol Events. Each Patrol offers exclusive rewards and counts toward your overall campaign progress. Finish the required objectives in each Patrol to earn your pick from the Campaign 2025 Mega Rewards pool. Missed earlier Patrols? No problem, buyouts are available, so you can still catch up.

sections.title: Third Patrol Event: Brainiac Returns
items: Brainiac has returned, and the fate of the city hangs in the balance. Patrol 3: Brainiac Returns runs from July 29 through August 25, dropping players into the heart of a full-scale invasion. Join forces with the Justice League and the Legion of Doom as they battle Brainiac’s forces (Ep. 47) across Bottled D.C.! This is a limited-time event! Log in and play daily to push back the invasion, earn event progress, and unlock exclusive rewards before time runs out!

sections.title: The Tides of War
items: During the summer, the seas become restless, churning with dangerous storms. Ocean Master, Aquaman’s conniving half brother, has rallied a force of mutineer Atlanteans in an attempt to usurp the throne of Atlantis! Their civil war has breached the waters of Metropolis, a crucial piece in the plot to rule the sea. Track Tides of War in your Mission Journal to venture into the Cave. Track Tides of War in your Mission Journal to find the Atleantean Frigates in Metropolis.

sections.title: Moon Legends Map Exclusive for The Last Laugh owners and Legendary members
items: Legendary members and owners of The Last Laugh will now be able to play the Moon Arena map as a Legends character.

sections.title: Vault Items Update
items: Three new military style gear set appearances ( Logistics Officer, Sharpshooter, Aeronaut - 24 new items total) have a chance to drop in the vault. Some older (launch) appearance items have been removed from the vault to make way for the new items and will continue to drop from NPC’s throughout the world.

sections.title: Bludhaven Alert Update
items: The toxicity of Bludhaven has decreased slightly over time resulting in enemies that are less threatening in some areas. The exception being Chemo whom now prevents his enemies from running away in fear.

sections.title: Bludhaven
items: Area 1:
Decreased the speed of the Half-Mutants to help prevent players from being overrun.
Area 2:
Adjusted the number of Chemoids that spawn in this area.
Area 3:
Increased the delay between mobs spawning from vats slightly.
Area 4 (Gauntlet and Boss Fight):
There are now fewer enemies when escorting the Hazmat personnel to Chemos last known location.
Hazmat personnel that die while being escorted will no longer respawn at the beginning.
Hazmat personnel have 2x health while being escorted and have 30% more time to be revived before being KO’d.
There is a solo Hazmat that has already located Chemo; he will speak with you when you finish clearing the gauntlet area. Chemo now creates a chemical barrier to keep his enemies from running.

sections.title: Shady Nightclub/ Police Station
items: Iconic NPCs are now more resistant to crowd control.

sections.title: Fire
items: Absorb Heat ability now displays multiple beam effects as intended.

sections.title: Counter Attack
items: The visual effect related to counter attacks (block breaking, block countering, interrupting) are no longer delayed.

sections.title: Metropolis
items: Gold Collections in Suicide Slums that were perfectly hidden inside of buildings have been moved so you can collect them.
Fixed various Gold Collection Locations in the Tomorrow District.

sections.title: Gotham City
items: Fixed various Gold Collection locations that were inside of structures and/or under the ground.
Moved a Gold Collection that was in danger of being sucked into a Paradox Rupture.
Fixed an issue where a Gold Collection was sunk into the ground south of the Knightsdome in Otisburg.
Fixed various Gold Collection locations in the Burnley district.
[Giordano Botanical Gardens]]: Moved a Collection Node out from inside of a building just south of the Botanical Gardens.

sections.title: Feats
items: My Life as a Robot will now correctly update for villains.

sections.title: General
items: Reduced the cost of resetting seasonal events to 12 Replay Badges (from 29).

sections.title: Marketplace
items: Adding a Sheer (the original) version of net leggings to the [Goth Leggings]] marketplace item. Purchasing the Goth Leggings from the Marketplace will now allow you to claim two versions of the item: one Sheer, and one not-Sheer. If you have already purchased the Goth Leggings, you will automatically be able to claim both versions from the Claim Window in the Marketplace UI.

sections.title: Headquarters Assault: Watchtower
items: Due to the unstable energies of the Fuel Cell the carrier is now vulnerable to lunges and melee combos. This vulnerability is apparent by the dizzy effects on the carrier.
Attack vulnerability while carrying the fuel cell will now only start after three seconds.
Corrected location of villain optional-mission reward barrels in the first stage. They should now spawn in the safe-area instead of out in the hangar.
Corrected positioning of villain safe-area door so there is no gap.

sections.title: City Safehouses
items: After carrying the Graviton Technology or the Force Field Disruptor for 3 seconds, the carrier will become vulnerable to Interruption.

sections.title: The Moon
items: Fixed an issue where weaponizing the rock did not interrupt the secure action.
Players who enter a Moon PvP match in progress will no longer experience a looping sound issue.

sections.title: S.T.A.R. Labs
items: Fixed an issue where Capture Points visual effect would activate when the Capture Point was not active at the beginning of a round.

sections.title: Fortress of Solitude: Chasm
items: Superman and Lex Luthor have agreed to stop failing to appear when you are fighting the Sunstone Herald.
Fixed an issue where a Briefing was located inside of a wall.

sections.title: Marketplace
items: The order success message when purchasing DLCs will now notify you that you will need to relaunch the game in order for DLC content to become available.
Descriptions in the Investigations, Briefings, and Collections UI may now be scrolled using the right analog stick.

sections.title: Visual
items: Spider Blade dual wield weapon has been reduced in size for brute sized characters to avoid clipping through the character body.
Wonder Woman's Headband style no longer clips into the forehead of male brute characters.
Sunstone Bulwark head style no longer causes facial hair to disappear.
High Voltage face style no longer clips into the brow of male brute characters wearing an animal skin style.
A number of environment fixes have been made throughout the game world.
Duct Tape Mask; No longer clips into the cheeks of male characters wearing animal skins.; No longer displays incorrectly on Striker model characters.

title: Game Update 160
summary: Game Updates continue to be a bit off compared to past posted entries on the DCUO forums.

sections.title: Overview
items: Heads Up!
Game Updates continue to be a bit off compared to past posted entries on the DCUO forums.
This is our best effort to accurately reflect this Game Update given a bit of hacking and detective work.
August 26, 2025
Homecoming is back, and Titans Island needs your help! Blackfire has launched a full-scale assault, and the Teen Titans are calling on all heroes to rise up and defend their home.

This year’s Homecoming brings fresh additions, including the brand-new Starbolt Iconic Ability, a Starfire Base NPC to liven up your lair, and a new collection The Art of Dance, which unlocks the flashy Rhythmic Run Emote. Plus, new feats and more!

sections.title: Homecoming Event
items: From 26 August 2025 through 22 September 2025, players can dive into challenges to earn Prize Tickets and unlock event rewards by logging in and playing daily.

sections.title: Event Rewards
items: Starbolt Iconic Ability (Unlimited) Red X Emblem (Unlimited) Pack of 40 Mogo Berries (Once Per Account) 10 Legendary Alliances (Once Per Account) 12 Perfected Exobyte - Gen. 15 (Once Per Account)

sections.title: Starbolt Iconic Ability
items: Introducing a brand-new iconic ability, Starbolt, available as the featured event reward during the Homecoming 2025 Event. Unlike most iconic abilities that carry high power costs and long cooldowns, Starbolt offers a more repeatable, combo-based approach perfect for Might DPS players looking to build supercharge more actively and creatively. Starbolt is unique in that it can be infinitely combo-ed, allowing players to chain attacks and generate additional supercharge with each use.

sections.title: New Vendor Rewards
items: Base Invitation: Starfire
Jitterbug Jazz Emote
Dance Journal
Son of the Bat Belt Style
Enhanced Red X Emblem
Titans Tower Diorama
Titans Room Divider
Titans Tower Window

references.label: Son of the Bat Belt Style

sections.title: New Starfire Base NPC
items: Bring the glow of Tamaran into your lair with the brand new Starfire Base NPC. This special base item can be placed like any other decoration, but with one important difference: you can interact with Starfire directly to start a conversation. She cannot be attacked or destroyed, making her a permanent and lively addition to your base.

Starfire comes with a full set of interactive dialogue options, featuring her unique perspective, personality, and voice lines. She’ll also share her thoughts about Homecoming, Earth, Tamaran, the Teen Titans, and even her fellow heroes.
Bring home Tamaran’s radiant glow and interact with Starfire herself in your base!

sections.title: Homecoming Event Buyout
items: Missed a few days of Homecoming? Don’t worry, you’ll still have a chance to unlock the Homecoming Event rewards! For one month after the event ends, players can use Marketplace Currency to buy out the event and immediately claim the rewards.

The buyout cost is prorated based on how many event days you have left unfinished. Each completed day lowers the total price by the price per day amount listed below. Members also enjoy an extra 10% discount on the final buyout cost.
Price per Day: 200 Total Days Required: 20 Total Price: 4000

sections.title: New Collection: The Art of Dance
items: Step into rhythm with the all-new Art of Dance collection, available for a limited time during Homecoming! This vibrant collection features a series of stylish items inspired by movement, music, and the joy of dancing.
Collect all the pieces in the set to unlock the Rhythmic Run Emote, letting your hero show off some smooth dance moves while running through Titans Island.

sections.title: New Feats
items: Tamaranean Torch
Flashloose
Guest Star
Footdance
Father's Legacy
Coming Home

sections.title: Upgraded Allies are Here!
items: The final batch of upgraded allies has arrived. To recap, this major rework changes how combat allies function. These changes are designed to make allies feel more impactful and present during fights. Previously, summoned allies would perform a single ability and then leave the battle, but with this update, allies will stick around and fight alongside you. Some allies now use their signature ability up to twice per summon and can draw aggro from enemies, acting like a true combat companion.
The second batch of updated allies includes:; Batman Who Laughs; Death Metal Batman; Poison Ivy; Starfire; Flashpoint Batman; Emperor Aquaman; Queen Diana; Bombshell Harley Quinn; Zatanna
Nubia's "To Me!" Signature Ability updated.
Enemies within 10 meters take full damage as before, and enemies beyond that up to 20 meters take half damage.
Adjustments made to Ally attack behavior

sections.title: Bases
items: Base Tracker now lists bases in the House of Legends correctly.

sections.title: Allies
items: All Allies should now share the same cooldown
Allies will now traverse to an enemy NPC instead of teleporting next to it
Cyborg's Energizing Drone ability and Superboy's Krypto's Aid ability no longer destroy pets summoned by Powerset abilities when activated
Cyborg's Energizing Drone ability now restores the expected 8% Power
Superboy now works with Shazam's Power of the Shazamily ability
Superboy now displays the correct icon on the Inspect menu

sections.title: Items
items: Nth Metal Detector effect should now apply even if it is consumed right before zoning or entering a cutscene.
Fixed numerous Supply Drop trinkets being improperly tagged as belonging to Tides of War 2021

sections.title: Styles
items: Lord of Lies Head style no longer improperly culls Face Styles

sections.title: Collections
items: The gold collections from Gotham Under Siege (DLC10) can now be collected by Premium/Free players. These include:; Themyscira Military Tokens; Broken Amazon Weapons; Themyscira Artifacts

title: Game Update 161

sections.title: Overview
items: Heads Up!
Game Updates continue to be a bit off compared to past posted entries on the DCUO forums.
